body:
Tested locally, it works as expected on all 3 linked MRPs.

By the way, when quitting the MRP of #121285 using the X button or <kbd>Alt + F4</kbd>, I always get a crash on this configuration. This also occurs on `master`, so it is not a regression from this PR:

```
handle_crash: Program crashed with signal 11
Engine version: Godot Engine v4.8.dev.custom_build (a5d71d7a66c6f4746ffc8540e7746482750c2413)
Dumping the backtrace. Please include this when reporting the bug on: https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues
Load address: 7f6c9c4ff000

[1] 7f6cbe7d2fb0 (libc.so.6+19fb0) - /lib64/libc.so.6(+0x19fb0) [0x7f6cbe7d2fb0]
[2] 7f6c1e7d5be3 (libnvidia-glcore.so.610.43.03+fd5be3) - /lib64/libnvidia-glcore.so.610.43.03(+0xfd5be3) [0x7f6c1e7d5be3]
[3] 7f6c1e23ffe7 (libnvidia-glcore.so.610.43.03+a3ffe7) - /lib64/libnvidia-glcore.so.610.43.03(+0xa3ffe7) [0x7f6c1e23ffe7]
[4] 7f6c9c550787 (main+51787) - /usr/lib64/libGLX_nvidia.so.0(+0x51787) [0x7f6c9c550787]
[5] 7f6c9c550eaf (main+51eaf) - /usr/lib64/libGLX_nvidia.so.0(+0x51eaf) [0x7f6c9c550eaf]
-- END OF C++ BACKTRACE --
```

Unfortunately, there doesn't seem to be a way to get more information from this backtrace as the crash is in the proprietary driver.

<details open>

<summary>PC specifications</summary>

- **CPU:** AMD Ryzen 9 9950X3D
- **GPU:** NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090 (driver 610.43.03)
- **RAM:** 64 GB (2×32 GB DDR5-6000 CL30)
- **SSD:** Solidigm P44 Pro 2 TB
- **OS:** Linux (Fedora 44)
</details>
Code looks good to me (I meant to approve this just above).
